tasks.title: Verify 100% data-qid coverage — 0 missing interactive elements
tasks.command:
cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/pi-mono &&
python3 -c "
import re, os, sys
base = 'packages/ux-lab/src/components/datalake-explorer'
total = 0; qid = 0; missing_files = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
    for fn in files:
        if not fn.endswith('.tsx'): continue
        path = os.path.join(root, fn)
        c = open(path).read()
        els = [e for e in re.split(r'<(?=button|input|select|div|span|label)', c) if re.search(r'on(?:Click|Change|DoubleClick)=', e)]
        q = [e for e in els if 'data-qid' in e[:e.find('>')+1 if e.find('>') > 0 else 500]]
        total += len(els); qid += len(q)
        if len(q) < len(els): missing_files.append((fn, len(els), len(q)))
pct = qid * 100 // total if total > 0 else 0
print(f'Coverage: {qid}/{total} ({pct}%)')
for fn, t, q in missing_files:
    print(f'  MISSING: {fn}: {t-q} elements without data-qid')
assert qid == total, f'FAIL: {total-qid} interactive elements missing data-qid'
print('PASS: 100% coverage')
"
